Bihar Museum Full Tour & Guide | Bihar's Largest Museum
Today's vlog is all about Bihar Museum situated at Bailey road, Patna. It was opened in August 2015. The children's museum, the main entrance area, orientation theatre, Historical Art Gallery, History Gallery and the main Wild Bihar Section is the highlight of Bihar Museum. More than 100 artifacts were transferred here from Patna Museum.
